title: Perturbation-based Regional Interpretability through Subtraction Mapping (PRISM): naming-error dissociations in language models and post-stroke aphasia
abstract: arXiv:2608.12717v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability of large language models lacks spatially resolved, falsifiable tools for testing whether internal components are specialized for distinct cognitive operations. We adapt subtraction analysis, the standard framework of human neuroimaging, from biological brains to perturbed transformers, and apply the same logic to both substrates in parallel. Building on the Brain-LLM Unified Model (BLUM), which showed that layer-perturbed LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B error profiles match the lesion patterns of aphasic patients, we develop PRISM (Perturbation-based Regional Interpretability through Subtraction Mapping). PRISM maps the seven clinical Philadelphia Naming Test categories, subtracts error classes pairwise, and treats each perturbation seed as a subject in a group analysis with threshold-free cluster enhancement along the layer axis. translated_title: 基于扰动的减法映射区域可解释性（PRISM）：语言模型与卒中后失语症中的命名错误分离
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型的机制可解释性缺乏具有空间分辨率和可证伪性的工具，用以测试内部组件是否专门用于不同的认知操作。我们将人类神经影像学的标准框架——减法分析，从生物大脑适配到扰动变换器，并同时对这两种基质应用相同的逻辑。基于脑-大语言模型统一模型（BLUM），该模型表明层扰动LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B的错误模式与失语症患者的病变模式相匹配，我们开发了PRISM（基于扰动的减法映射区域可解释性）。PRISM映射七个临床费城命名测试类别，成对减去错误类别，并将每个扰动种子视为组分析中的一个受试者，沿层轴使用无阈值聚类增强。我们对213名慢性卒中后失语症患者进行了结构匹配的分析。
tldr: 本文提出PRISM方法，将神经影像学中的减法分析应用于扰动语言模型，通过成对错误类别相减识别内部组件的认知特化，并验证了与失语症患者病变模式的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PRISM, which adapts subtraction analysis from neuroimaging to perturbed language models, identifying cognitive specialization of internal components via pairwise error-class subtraction, and validates consistency with lesion patterns in aphasia patients.
